name: Cody Hattrich
source:
Cody is the 29 year old owner of the biggest chain of casinos in Vegas. His recently deceased father left him everything in his will, and Cody has not been idle with what has been given to him. Inheriting a fortune has done nothing to quench his seemingly insatiable, gambling-oriented personality.

Despite having access to anything his heart desires, Cody maintains a restrained persona in most situations. He does love good food, alcohol, and gambling, but what he loves even more is having someone to show it all off to.

Cody can usually be found catering to high profile guests at his favorite casino, the NGN Great.
